propositions: CI workflows must apply --filter=blob:none to all tickets-branch fetch paths in actions/checkout@v7 steps, Gerrit depth-1 require-ticket fetches, and full-history verify-identity fetches while preserving existing fetch-depth and credential/ref settings.

Pack size guards must validate that standalone checkouts stay below 102400 KiB and Gerrit identity checkouts stay below 131072 KiB after partial-clone materialization, rejecting unfiltered all-history fetches that exceed these thresholds.

Git protocol must advertise filter capability and send blob:none filter requests in both named-origin inheritance and direct-URL fetch paths, leaving large historical blobs missing until materialization.

Identity workflow isolation must be enforced: standalone and Gerrit identity jobs must not introduce additional promisor objects beyond materialization, verified by comparing before/after git count-objects -v snapshots.

Real-Git fixture must simulate partial-clone protocol negotiation with git daemon, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL-based filter allowance, packet tracing, and threshold repositories exceeding 140 MiB removed blob plus sub-1 MiB tip.
Blobless partial-clone tickets must support independent local/remote changes, merge-base era scoping, commit graph traversal, and successful push of merged results with the ours driver.
